bitfield.description: When true desertion of QualCca in 11b packets will be aligned with the 4uSec boundary integer multiple

When true desertion of QualCca in HT and VHT packets will be aligned with the 4uSec boundary integer multiple. This is required by protocol (to align the ack or the slots following a short-guard-interval packet between HT/VHT and legacy devices).
When false desertion of QualCca in HE packets with no HE-SIG-A CRC error will NOT be aligned with the 4uSec boundary integer multiple.

When true desertion of QualCca in HE packets with HE-SIG-A CRC error or with HE-SIG-A reserved field, will be aligned with the 4uSec boundary integer multiple. (since RxTime is calculated from the L-SIG in this case).
When true desertion of QualCca in packets which are not mentioned above, will be aligned with the 4uSec boundary integer multiple.
When Allow4UsecAlignmentFwOvrd is true, this register is used to enable the 4uSec alignment. When true desertion of QualCca will be aligned with the 4uSec boundary integer multiple.
